column1: # Follow-up probes for ints beyond 64 bits (#724): what OpenVerse prints is in each probe's header and in note; the Book's expectation where it has one.

column5: note
OpenVerse: quotient failed|mod failed|floor failed. A runtime error would mean heap ints treat a zero divisor apart.
OpenVerse: tie to even|above tie up|odd tie up (round to nearest, ties to even).
Risky. OpenVerse: big computed|infinity. A runtime error would stop the session after big computed.
Risky. The API reference: a halting integer-bounds error outside 64 bits; OpenVerse agrees. The Verse VM might give an int beyond 64 bits (floor above).
OpenVerse: index failed|negative index failed|set failed.
OpenVerse: count 4|two above.
OpenVerse: found 2^63|found 2^126|one entry.
The Book's MaxLengthBits (2^20) for shifts; this reaches the longest int by multiplication.
Risky. OpenVerse raises the overflow error at 2^(2^20) by multiplication, as the Book's shifts do; without a limit for multiplication Epic prints squared.
OpenVerse computes it at run time: above. A 9003 refusal would mean every module constant is evaluated in 64 bits.
OpenVerse refuses at compile time (integer add overflow on the way); admitted, it prints back to max.
Control: both admit and print max.
Risky. OpenVerse: in range, then the overflow error (as Epic does for interpolation).
The Book: literals must fit in 64 bits. OpenVerse refuses.
OpenVerse: floor 2^63|ceil 2^63 + 1|reduced.
OpenVerse: min max|clamp|sgn|containers equal.
OpenVerse: quotient -4|mod D - 1|floor -4|ceil -3.
